title: 第23章 红尘教红尘路第24章 司情仙子红尘妖女
slug: 从天牢走出的魔尊她们怕了
content_zh:
“红尘教，以三千红尘为道，与其余超凡脱俗的不朽道统相反，红尘教入凡尘，红尘教每一代最出色的弟子，为红尘女，不知真名，有人称为红尘妖女，有人称为红尘仙子。”
“红尘教，非道非佛非魔，极为神秘，最古老的道统之一。”
“传闻初代红尘仙尊，与魔祖有关系。”
“古老，又扎根于红尘，红尘教知晓许多秘密，而且传闻红尘教与奉天教，颇为不对付。”
白骨夫人把所知晓的红尘教一股脑说出来。
红尘妖女的大名。
两年前在隐龙城夜洐也听说过。
在坊间传闻极多，尤其在男人中。
同时红尘妖女，背的黑锅也是世上最多的。
有女子红杏出墙。
有男人窥探他人媳妇，成了曹贼。
一旦被抓奸，为了洗脱污名，都会说一句，我没错，我一定是被红尘妖女挂上红线。
红尘教，所拥有的奇术极多，但流传最广，是红线。
偏偏红尘教人，不似其他仙宗弟子居于九霄云外，红尘教人，以各种身份形象藏身于万千红尘中，伪装能力无敌，不主动暴露难以被识破。
因此有关红尘教的传闻野史，广为流传。
有野史传出。
千年前，有太后惹了红尘仙尊，红尘仙尊给太后与小和尚暗中牵了红线，造成皇室史无前例丑闻。
一旦把两人牵上红线，稍有不慎，二者就会陷入**之中，做出难以启齿的事出来。
“继续。”
夜洐听八卦津津有味。

“其实这都是愚昧世人对红尘教的偏见，红尘教只收女弟子，但绝不是世人所认为的放荡女子，反而比那些仙子更为忠贞不二。”杀人寇眼中流露出痴迷与狂热：
“仙子也有堕落的，也有红杏出墙。”
“也是仙子成道后，抛弃为她付出一切的男人。”
“但红尘教弟子，一旦认定一个男人，就是生死与共，绝不独活，而且绝不吃醋，甘愿伏低做小，任打任骂也不背叛。”
“一个男人再平凡，如果能得到红尘教弟子的倾心，算是不朽道统的道子，也会羡慕。”
“可惜，让红尘教弟子倾心太难了，自古以来，出现这种事屈指可数。”
杀人寇满是遗憾。
他有自知之明，自己不配。
“那红尘女？”夜洐很好奇，弟子都如此，那红尘妖女？或者红尘仙尊？
“没这种可能，自古以来，从未出现过，天命所归的气运之子，惊才绝艳的天骄，都不曾被红尘女倾心，传说......曾经的秦皇，一代霸主，开天辟地祖庭级别人物，镇压一个时代，想要纳当代红尘仙尊为后，也没成功。”杀人寇毫不犹豫说道。
“最可笑，就是千年前大瑞朝皇帝，喝醉后敢作不雅之诗，觊觎红尘仙尊，太后大言不惭说，这是红尘仙尊的福分。”
“结果，就是皇室最大丑闻出现，似乎大瑞朝暗中还付出更大的代价。”
夜洐不禁感叹，这些不朽道统的底蕴与可怕。
那红尘弟子，不得不见。
红尘教幻化万千身份能力，想要。
想知道奉天教的事。
想了解大瑞朝真正的实力。
夜洐还想得知，有关极阳与雷霆方面的教主法。
教主法，只存在不朽道统中。
世俗中想要得知寻找，犹如大海捞针，几乎不可能。

“红尘教，每一代只有九位正式弟子，每人统御一艘红尘船，游历人间，九位弟子最出色则为红尘女。”怨鬼搜集的消息最多：
“我在北洲城听闻，有一艘红尘船，即将进入北洲。”
content_en:
"The Hongchen Sect takes three thousand mortals as its Tao. Contrary to other otherworldly and immortal Taoist traditions, the Red Dust Sect enters the mortal world. The most outstanding disciple of each generation of the Red Dust Sect is the Red Dust Girl. I don't know her real name. Some people call her the Red Dust Demon Girl, and some call her the Red Dust Fairy."
"The Hongchen Sect is neither Tao, Buddha nor demon. It is extremely mysterious and one of the oldest Taoist traditions."
"It is rumored that the first generation of the Red Dust Immortal Lord is related to the Demon Ancestor."
"It is ancient and rooted in the world of mortals. The Hongchen Sect knows many secrets, and it is rumored that the Hongchen Sect and the Fengtian Sect are quite difficult to deal with."
Mrs. Bones told everything she knew about the Red World Sect.
The name of the mortal witch.
I also heard about it in Yinlong City two years ago.
There are many rumors, especially among men.
At the same time, the mortal witch takes the most blame in the world.
A woman, Hongxing, cheated on her.
A man spies on other people's wives and becomes a thief.
Once caught in an act of rape, in order to clear away the stigma, they would say, "I'm not wrong, I must have been hung up by a mortal witch."
The Hongchen Sect possesses many magical arts, but the most widely spread is the Red Line.
However, the Hongchen Cult is not like other disciples of the Immortal Sect who live outside the sky. The Hongchen Cult hides in thousands of mortals with various identities and images. Its disguise ability is invincible and it is difficult to be seen through without taking the initiative to expose itself.
Therefore, rumors and unofficial histories about Hongchen Sect are widely circulated.
There is some unofficial history.
Thousands of years ago, the Queen Mother offended the Hongchen Immortal Lord, who secretly led the Queen Mother and the young monk, causing an unprecedented scandal in the history of the royal family.
Once two people are put on the red line, if they are not careful, the two will fall into passion and do unspeakable things.
"Continue."
Ye Xi listened to the gossip with great interest.
"Actually, this is the ignorant world's prejudice against the Hongchen Sect. The Hongchen Sect only accepts female disciples, but they are by no means the loose women that the world thinks. On the contrary, they are more loyal and loyal than those fairies." The murderer's eyes revealed obsession and fanaticism:
"There are fairies who fall, and there are also red apricots who cheat."
"It was also the fairy who abandoned the man who had given everything for her after she became enlightened."
"But disciples of the Hongchen Sect, once they recognize a man, they will share life and death with him. They will never live alone, and they will never be jealous. They are willing to be humble and cowardly, and will not betray anyone regardless of being beaten or scolded."
"No matter how ordinary a man is, if he can win the admiration of a disciple of the Hongchen Sect, even a Taoist disciple of the Immortal Tradition will be envious."
"Unfortunately, it is too difficult to win the hearts of the disciples of Hongchen Sect. Since ancient times, this kind of thing has happened only a handful of times."
The murderer was full of regrets.
He knows himself that he is not worthy.
"Then the mortal girl?" Ye Tao was very curious, as all the disciples were, but the mortal demon girl? Or the Immortal Lord of the Red Dust?
"There is no such possibility. Since ancient times, there has never been a fateful son, a talented and talented genius, who has never been enamored by a mortal woman. According to legend... the former Qin Emperor, a generation overlord, a founder of the ancestral family, suppressed an era, and wanted to accept the contemporary mortal immortal as his queen, but he failed." The murderer said without hesitation.
"The most ridiculous thing is that the emperor of the Darui Dynasty a thousand years ago dared to write indecent poems when he was drunk and coveted the Red Dust Immortal Lord. The Queen Mother brazenly said that this was the blessing of the Red Dust Immortal Lord."
"As a result, the biggest scandal in the royal family emerged, and it seems that Darui Chao secretly paid a greater price."
Ye Hao couldn't help but sigh at the depth and horror of these immortal traditions.
I have to meet that Hongchen disciple.
The Hongchen Sect has the ability to transform into thousands of identities and wants.
I want to know about Fengtianjiao.
I want to know the true strength of Darui Chao.
Ye Tao also wanted to know about the teaching methods of Jiyang and Thunder.
The teachings of the Lord only exist in the immortal Taoism.
Trying to find out and find it in the secular world is like finding a needle in a haystack, it is almost impossible.
"The Red Dust Sect has only nine official disciples in each generation. Each one controls a Red Dust Ship and travels around the world. The most outstanding of the nine disciples is the Red Dust Girl." The resentful ghost collected the most information.:
"I heard in Beizhou City that there is a mortal ship that is about to enter Beizhou."
